I have been a loyal client of this veterinary office for over a decade and have trusted them with the care of my pets for many years. Unfortunately, my recent experience led me to make the difficult decision to transfer my pets’ care elsewhere.

I want to be very clear that I was late to my appointment. I mistakenly believed my appointment time was 10:30 when it was actually scheduled for 10:20, and I arrived approximately 11–12 minutes late. I understand that clinics have schedules to maintain and late policies to follow, and I do take responsibility for my mistake.

However, what was most disappointing was not the policy itself, but the way the situation was handled. The interaction felt cold and dismissive, with little acknowledgment of my long history as a client. A more empathetic approach or even a brief expression of understanding would have made a significant difference in how the situation felt.

Over the past few years, I have also noticed a shift in the office atmosphere, including the departure of long-term staff members who had previously contributed to a warm, relationship-based environment. In addition, the practice no longer appears to provide reminders for upcoming vaccination needs, which places more responsibility on pet owners to track preventive care timelines independently. This recent experience reinforced my sense that the overall level of customer support and proactive communication has changed.

I understand the need for scheduling policies and accept responsibility for my lateness; however, I hope this feedback encourages reflection on how those policies are communicated and on the importance of valuing loyal, long-standing clients.

We had one of our cats scheduled. She has been coughing frequently and she had some breathing problems previously that required an after hours emergency visit to another clinic. We had been to this vet before with a different cat. We got scheduled and then we got a call and they wanted us to go elsewhere because they had an emergency. We said I think she's ok to wait another day, so we rescheduled. They rescheduled us to the next day. Next day comes and we get called again to reschedule, there is yet again an emergency. So we're on Monday now. We get another call to reschedule to the afternoon. Fine. Get a call in the afternoon to cancel. They'd like us to go elsewhere because they have another emergency. So I ask them, do you not see animals for regular clinic visits? She said yes. I said do you only have one doctor to see patients? She said yes. So I told her we would not ever be back because I don't like the way we've been treated. I completely understand that doing a surgery is going to bring in more revenue than a regular office visit but is it ok to reschedule someone multiple times and then cancel their appointment? Not good business in my opinion and pretty soon, you won't have any patients if you treat them all like that.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

Dr. Maggi and Audrey were especially wonderful. They were friendly, genuinely attentive, and took the time to understand both my needs and my cat’s. I left with a practical, affordable care plan that felt tailored to us. I’m really grateful to have found a clinic that listens and cares.

I am forever grateful for Acorn Animal Hill. My dog was recently diagnosed with a life-threatening infection, and it was one of the most terrifying experiences a pet owner can face. Trying to find a veterinarian who wasn’t astronomically priced and could perform emergency surgery felt impossible—until we found Acorn Animal Hill.
They welcomed us when we were at our most desperate to help our sweet Zoey. The entire team went above and beyond to save her life, treating her with a level of care, compassion, and dedication that I’ve never experienced from a veterinary clinic. Every staff member we spoke with was kind, patient, and thorough, helping us fully understand Zoey’s condition and the treatment she needed.
Because of them, Zoey is now home, resting comfortably, and already doing so much better just one day after surgery. They turly saved her life.
Thank you to the incredible staff and veterinarian at Acorn Animal Hill—you are heroes in our eyes.
They saved my dog’s life not once but TWICE! I wouldn’t take my animals anywhere else. Dr. Mahonski is an angel on planet Earth!

I hate this place for lying to me. My poor dog has been struggling with an ear infection and I told this horrible woman that I was giving her every last dime I had last week to pay for medicine for my dog. I told her 300 was all I had, so she made sure she took all 300 just to flush out ONE of her ears and suggest a medicine. But she PROMISED ME that she would give me TWO refills for the medicine to ensure it had time to work. This was a blatant and manipulative lie!!! There were no refills and a few days later when poor maze still hadn’t gotten better the only option she gave me was to come back in for another appointment and spend at least another 150 dollars on a follow up appointment. She’s just about the money. She lies to your face to make you feel like things are okay and she’s on your side, but the only thing she cares about is cold hard cash. I don’t know what I’m going to do about my poor dog. I’m out 300 dollars and she isn’t even slightly better. I’m going to seek out another vet who actually cares for the animals they treat and wants the best for them. I’m not just a revenue stream. I’m a human being with an animal that needed your help, and instead you just juiced me for every dime I had left and gave me absolutely zero results. Then you stuck your hand back out for more money. I know you are probably desensitized because of how many dissatisfied patients you’ve had in the past, but we are real people you are hurting with your scam of a business. I hope for is real and is watching you.

I never feel rushed or like just a number here and even my scaredycat is at ease here! I know no one ever wants to think about putting down their precious pet, but Acorn Hill gave us the best case scenario in saying goodbye to our beloved Bailey.

After two years of helping us treat her for terminal heart disease and kidney failure, it was time to let go. Everyone was so kind. They gave us as much time as we needed to say goodbye. I wanted Bailey to experience the outdoors one last time, and they let us lay in their yard out back.

The techs brought us blankets, clipped her fur to make keepsakes for us, and were so kind throughout the entire ordeal. Dr. Hartwig and her team are incredible. We ended up getting to let her pass outside, cuddled up in the arms of the people she loved most.

I am so incredibly grateful to this clinic for giving Bailey they best care possible up until her last breath. Thank you so much for all that you do.

If you're looking for a veterinarian that truly cares about your pet and YOU, look no further. Absolutely incredible staff here.

Rest in paradise Bailey, you were the best girl. We love you so much.

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Acorn Hill Animal Hospital in San Antonio. From the very first visit, they’ve been everything I hoped for in a veterinary clinic and more. I was fortunate to have them recommended to me when I was looking for a new vet for my dog, and from day one, they’ve treated us like family.

Throughout my dog’s life, Acorn Hill provided exceptional care, whether it was routine check-ups, dental cleanings, or even surgery, their team was always professional, compassionate, and incredibly responsive. If my pup ever had an unexpected illness or issue, they always did their best to get us in quickly and address his needs right away.

In Skylar’s senior years, when his health started to decline, Acorn Hill continued to be a source of support and guidance. They helped me understand his changing needs and were so patient and kind through it all. When the time came for my beloved dog to cross the rainbow bridge, they walked me through that heartbreaking process with such compassion and grace. I couldn’t have asked for a more caring team to be there during that difficult moment.

Thank you, Acorn Hill Animal Hospital, for the years of excellent care and for being there every step of the way. You made a difference in both my dog’s life and mine, and I will always be grateful.

I am very disappointed with Acorn Hill now and have transferred all her records and future care to the animal hospital that was willing to help.
